proxy_execution.guidance: rtk proxy executes an executable argv, not shell assignments or builtins. Put TMPDIR=/tmp before rtk proxy, or use rtk proxy env TMPDIR=/tmp true; run shell builtins in the calling shell without an RTK prefix.
